doc.search_volume_trend: Flat array [period,value,period,value...]. Monthly:yyyyMM; Weekly:yyyyMMdd week start date. Value is keyword search volume. (All elements are strings; flat key-value array by month, even index = month yyyyMM, odd index = search volume of that month)
doc.rank_trend: ABA search rank trend, flat array same format as search_volume_trend. Smaller number means better rank. (All elements are strings; smaller value represents higher ranking)
doc.cpc_trend: CPC trend 4-tuple array:[yyyyMM, cpc, minCpc, maxCpc...], unit:cent. Only return when type=2 monthly. (USD)
